case.summary: This alert was triggered when the bank's real-time risk score flagged an online transaction of $100.09 with a score of 0.57. The transaction model scored the event at a low 0.140, and graph evidence showed the device profile had already been used three times on this card prior to the alert. Although a hidden proxy was used, the purchase amount was typical for the customer, and the cardholder confirmed making the transaction when contacted. The verdict is legitimate, and the final actions are ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
